nameEn: Manufacture of gas; distribution of gaseous fuels through mains
description: This class includes the manufacture of gas and the distribution of gaseous fuels through a system of mains.
includes: manufacture of gaseous fuels with a specified calorific value by carbonization, gasification and other processes (coal gas, water gas, producer gas, similar gases)
transport and distribution of gaseous fuels through mains
sale of gas to the user through mains
liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) distribution and trade through mains
excludes: extraction and refining of natural gas, see 0620
